source: Client CSV 2026-10-14 (segmentation by product/technology, service/business model, application, end user, geography); cap 120, one browser per market, global search with the focus countries first
market_definition: The Global Geospatial Analytics / GIS Market covers companies providing the following. Products and technology: Software: desktop GIS, web/mobile GIS, enterprise GIS; data: satellite, drone, LiDAR, IoT, demographic and cadastral data; technology: AI/ML, cloud, edge, GNSS. Services and business models: Software licensing/SaaS, data acquisition, geodatabase development, consulting and implementation, managed GIS services, custom application development. Applications: Urban planning, land administration, utilities, transportation, agriculture, environment, disaster management, defense, smart cities. End users: Government, utilities, telecom, construction, transportation, agriculture, mining, environmental agencies, enterprises. Geography: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Middle East & Africa; India-specific municipal and state-level opportunity analysis.
core_scope: A core player itself provides GIS and geospatial analytics solutions under its own name: desktop, web / mobile or enterprise GIS software, geospatial analytics platforms, geospatial data acquisition and geodatabase development, GIS consulting, implementation and managed GIS services, or custom geospatial applications. Diversified technology or engineering firms with a dedicated GIS / geospatial line qualify.
adjacent_segments: General IT services firms with no GIS / geospatial practice
